notes: Two defects found by driving a real studio in a browser, not by reading. First: the agent room imported agent/live-state directly, and every app under /apps is a separate bundle, so it read its own permanently empty copy - mounted as an app it said 'no screen has described itself yet' from every screen while the identical component in the floating panel worked. Reproduced before the fix and re-proved after: from the Library it now says 'Standing on The Library', from Docs 'Standing on Help / Docs'. Second: only five of eleven apps ever call ctx.agent.publish, so from the other six there was no reading at all; the shell now publishes a bare snapshot on mount, excluding the agent itself. The room.test.tsx double was rewritten to drive the seam through ctx - the old one published into the module the room imported, which is why it certified a room nobody could use. Not an independent pass: written and approved in one turn.
